Subject: Unable to accept Zip onboarding invite — SAML/2FA error

Hi Irene / Laura,

We received the supplier portal invite for Startholdings and I tried to accept it this morning, but the flow fails as soon as my Okta session posts the SAML response. After I authenticate with our Okta MFA, the browser redirects back to the Zip onboarding page and shows a 403-like error: "SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL mismatch". I attached a screenshot of the final page (invite-screenshot.png) and a trimmed saml response in saml-error-log.txt (redacted).

Steps I took:
- Clicked the invite link from the email (on Chrome, macOS Monterey)
- Redirect to our Okta login, completed password + Duo push
- Okta posts SAML to the RelayState / ACS endpoint and then the portal shows the error above

We need to get this unblocked — we have a PO pending that requires the supplier to be active today. Can you confirm whether Redwood can manually activate the vendor or reissue an invite with a different flow?

I can provide timestamps and the SAML POST if that helps, but we can't share full Okta logs externally. Attached: saml-error-log.txt (redacted) and screenshot.

Thanks,
Michael Ross
Head of Procurement
Startholdings LLC

Hi Michael — thanks for the details and attachments, very helpful.

Sorry you're blocked. A couple quick asks so we can triage:
- Can you confirm the exact timestamp of the failure (including timezone) from your saml post?
- If possible, open the invite link in an incognito window and try again (sometimes cookie relay/third-party cookies cause the ACS URL to be rewritten).
- Do you see the ACS URL in the saml-error-log.txt? The error text you sent sounds like a RelayState / ACS mismatch (our system expects the ACS for the "zip-onboard" app, but some tenant configurations append a trailing slash or extra query params which cause a strict mismatch).

Short-term options we can do from our side:
- Manual activation: we can create the vendor account in the portal and mark it active so your PO can be processed immediately. You'll get a one-time activation link to set a password.
- Reissue the invite with an alternative flow (admin-generated activation token) that doesn't rely on the redirect relay.

If you want the manual activation, I'll loop in Ben (engineering) to perform it and confirm any audit logs for compliance. Also, if you'd like to upload the W-9 to our secure intake, we can attach it to the vendor record while we resolve the SAML mapping.

Irene
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unable to accept Zip onboarding invite — SAML assertion consumer URL mismatch

Hi all — I looked at the redacted SAML POST and the invite redirect trace. Root cause: when an invite is generated for the Zip flow we embed relayState that expects the ACS endpoint to match exactly (we canonicalize without trimming trailing slashes). For certain Okta enterprise apps that normalize the ACS without a trailing slash we ended up with mismatch on verification and return a 403 with that message.

Short-term mitigation performed (completed now):
- I manually created the vendor record in the portal and set it to ACTIVE (audit record created).
- Generated a one-time activation URL that uses the admin activation path (bypasses the redirect-ACS strict check). That link was emailed to Michael at 16:06 PST.
- Attached admin activation audit snippet admin-activation-log.txt for your records.

Next steps (engineering fix):
- INF-3217: relax canonicalization to accept ACS with/without trailing slash and strip known benign query params for the Zip redirect path. I'm pushing that to the July 29 sprint.

Compliance note: manual activation is recorded and we attached your W-9 to the vendor file as requested. If you need additional evidence for audit, we can export the activation event and sign-off.

Ben Carter
SRE, Redwood Inference
